Verified answer: B. The interpretation that "不时不食" means not eating out-of-season vegetables only makes sense if out-of-season vegetables existed in Confucius's era, alongside seasonal ones. If they did not exist, the interpretation fails, so B is a necessary assumption.

The other options are not required. A (Confucius was demanding about diet) is background and not needed for this reading. C concerns what "we" can choose today, not his era. D (diet shapes the mind) is irrelevant to the interpretation.
